determinism.scope: Two complete offline builds in separate disposable copies, separated by more than two seconds. Every generated workbook, CSV and site data snapshot compared byte-for-byte across both builds and candidate. No generated files copied back.
determinism.core_date_note: Archive timestamps describe deterministic formatting, not source retrieval or review dates.

full_regression_status: Whole-repository and independent source-boundary regressions are reported separately by the integrating parent. This independent audit verifies pinned source precision, actual local JavaScript consumers, deterministic builds, and every exported cell and hyperlink.
limitations: Local-only audit; no network, browser, source-page revisit or refetch, remote write, deployment or publication. Source-content review remains the separately pinned independent review.

Expected ordinary workbook values use unchanged baseline-pinned table projection functions, validated against exact canonical data and source boundaries. Changed teaching/scope values, roster snapshot projection, URL eligibility and person-row navigation suppression are independently derived, never taken from the changed exporter.
JavaScript rendering uses a minimal local DOM harness, not visual browser review. Workbooks use openpyxl and ZIP/CRC inspection, not Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice visual review.
Deterministic bytes are established for the recorded Python/openpyxl toolchain, not arbitrary future toolchains.
Roster records and raw observations are not unique-person or verified-current-employment totals. Partial career samples do not establish complete school/category coverage.
